settings.label: About this clip
settings.text: Our biggest clip, built for thick, long or curly hair. It twists into a quick updo, holds wet or dry and fits in a tote without snapping. Awarded best of the year by a beauty editors' panel.

settings.label: Material + size
settings.text: Cut from plant-based cellulose acetate. About four inches long and one and a half inches deep. Each swirl is poured by hand, so patterns differ slightly from the photo.

settings.label: Care + sold-out colours
settings.text: Wipe with a damp cloth and keep away from heat. If your colour is gone, join the waitlist and we will email you the moment it is back.

settings.title: Plant-based acetate
settings.text: A renewable, polished material that feels smooth in the hand and breaks down more kindly than plastic.

settings.title: Spring that stays tight
settings.text: Wide teeth and a firm steel spring keep thick hair in place through a full day.

settings.title: One-of-a-kind swirls
settings.text: Colours are mixed by hand, so each clip carries its own marbling.

settings.title: Wet or dry
settings.text: Clip up damp hair after a shower or wear it straight out of bed.

settings.heading: Finish the style
settings.text: A brush, a scrunchie and a spritz of scent round out the look.
